mwspt4enrgldk.title: Applying for a Kitchen Hand Position - Social
mwspt4enrgldk.briefing: This dialogue is an in-person conversation between an English-speaking restaurant manager and a job seeker who is looking for work as a kitchen hand. The job seeker visits the restaurant to ask whether the position is still available. The dialogue begins now.

segs.text: Good afternoon. Would you like a table, or would you like to order takeaway?
segs.ref: 下午好。您是想在店里用餐，还是想点外卖？

segs.text: 你好，都不是。我是来找工作的，不知道你们厨房帮手的职位还有没有空缺？
segs.ref: Hello, neither, actually. I'm here to look for work. I was wondering whether you still have any vacancies for a kitchen hand.

segs.text: We're often looking for new staff. What experience do you have working in restaurants, and why did you choose this restaurant?
segs.ref: 我们经常招聘新员工。你有哪些餐厅工作经验？为什么选择我们这家餐厅？

segs.text: 我已经在餐厅工作五年了，但我之前在市区工作的那家餐厅要关门了。
segs.ref: I've been working in restaurants for five years, but the restaurant I was working at in the city is closing down.

segs.text: It seems like many restaurants in the city are closing down. What different kinds of work can you do?
segs.ref: 看来市区有不少餐厅都在关门。你能做哪些不同类型的工作？

segs.text: 我可以在厨房工作，会做清洁、准备食物，还可以接电话订单。
segs.ref: I can work in the kitchen. I can do cleaning, prepare food and take phone orders.

segs.text: I often need people who are happy to work on Friday and Saturday nights. Which nights are you available?
segs.ref: 我经常需要愿意在星期五和星期六晚上上班的员工。你哪些晚上有空？

segs.text: 你什么时候需要我都可以。我每天晚上都有空。我白天没有工作，周末也不常去聚会。
segs.ref: I can work whenever you need me. I'm available every evening, I don't have a daytime job, and I don't often go to parties on weekends.

segs.text: In that case, you probably could start this weekend. I'll give you an application form to fill in.
segs.ref: 既然如此，你可能这周末就能开始上班。我给你一份申请表填写。

segs.text: 非常感谢！这里离我住的地方很近，我就住在下一条街。工作地点离家近真好。
segs.ref: Thank you very much! This restaurant is very close to where I live. I live in the next street. It's great to work close to home.

segs.text: Please bring your completed application form back later today. We offer good wages and provide staff meals.
segs.ref: 请在今天晚些时候把填好的申请表交回来。我们提供优厚的工资和员工餐。

segs.text: 我想你会觉得我是个好员工。我做人踏实，做事认真负责，而且很容易与别人相处。
segs.ref: I think you'll find that I'm a good employee. I'm down-to-earth, take my work seriously, am responsible and get along well with others.

segs.text: That's great. It sounds like a great match. Bring your application form back later this afternoon, and you can start this Friday.
segs.ref: 那太好了。听起来你很适合这份工作。今天下午晚些时候把申请表交回来，你这周五就可以开始上班。

segs.text: 太好了！我没想到这么快就找到工作了，真是松了一口气。我现在就回家把表填好，下午见。
segs.ref: That's wonderful! I didn't expect to find a job so quickly. What a relief! I'll go home and fill in the form now. See you this afternoon.

mwsqpzk9xcms4.title: Acting Lessons for Children - Education
mwsqpzk9xcms4.briefing: This dialogue is an in-person conversation between an English-speaking organiser at a local theatre and a parent who wants to enrol his daughter in acting lessons for children. The dialogue begins now.

segs.text: Hi, welcome to the Green Room Theatre. My assistant mentioned you were interested in acting lessons for children.
segs.ref: 你好，欢迎来到绿屋剧院。我的助理提到，您对儿童表演课程感兴趣。

segs.text: 是的，我女儿想当女演员。我觉得在剧院学习会是一个很好的开始。
segs.ref: Yes, my daughter wants to be an actress. I think learning at a theatre would be a good start.

segs.text: This will be the best place to start. We don't run an acting school, but we do run acting lessons for children during the school holidays.
segs.ref: 这里会是最好的起点。我们不经营表演学校，但我们确实在学校假期期间开设儿童表演课程。

segs.text: 这里确实是一个很好的起点。请问课程持续多长时间？费用是多少？
segs.ref: This is certainly a good place to start. How long does the course last, and how much does it cost?

segs.text: It's usually from 8 am to 11 am, Monday to Friday, for one week, and the week costs 200 dollars.
segs.ref: 课程通常从星期一到星期五，每天上午八点到十一点，持续一周，一周的费用是两百澳元。

segs.text: 听起来很不错。我会帮她报名，她应该会很兴奋。请问她需要带什么吗？
segs.ref: That sounds great. I'll enrol her, and she should be very excited. Does she need to bring anything?

segs.text: No, we will prepare the costumes and food, but you need to fill in a form about any allergies and medical concerns.
segs.ref: 不需要，我们会准备服装和食物，但你需要填写一份关于任何过敏和健康问题的表格。

segs.text: 幸好我问了。这家当地剧院很漂亮，我以前从来没有来这里看过剧。
segs.ref: I'm glad I asked. This local theatre is beautiful. I've never been here to see a play before.

segs.text: I can add you to our email newsletter list, so you can receive information about new plays.
segs.ref: 我可以把您加入我们的电子通讯订阅名单，这样您就能收到有关新剧目的信息。

segs.text: 好的，谢谢。下次如果有适合全家看的剧，我会带女儿来看，她一定会很开心。
segs.ref: Yes, please. Thank you. Next time there is a play suitable for the whole family, I'll bring my daughter to see it. She'll be very happy.

segs.text: Please do. We have four to five plays every year. We often have roles available for children, and your daughter can come to the audition for a role.
segs.ref: 欢迎你们来。我们每年会上演四到五部戏。我们经常有适合儿童的角色，您的女儿可以来参加角色试镜。

segs.text: 我之前不知道没有经验也可以参加试镜。我觉得她会喜欢当地剧院的活动的。
segs.ref: I didn't know she could audition without any experience. I think she'll enjoy the activities at the local theatre.

segs.text: Everyone begins with no experience. We welcome new members, and we also need people to help run things on show nights.
segs.ref: 每个人一开始都没有经验。我们欢迎新成员，也需要有人在演出当晚帮忙处理各项事务。

segs.text: 非常感谢。我会把电子邮箱地址给你，用来接收电子通讯。相信我们很快就会再见。
segs.ref: Thank you very much. I'll give you my email address so I can receive the email newsletter. I'm sure we'll see each other again soon.

mwsqqi4trpjzi.title: Skin Check and Sun Protection III - Medical
mwsqqi4trpjzi.briefing: This dialogue is between an English-speaking doctor and a patient at a skin clinic. The patient has come for a skin check and is discussing the importance of regular skin checks and ways to protect the skin from sun damage. The dialogue begins now.

segs.text: Hi, welcome to our clinic. I believe you are here to have a skin check today.
segs.ref: 您好，欢迎来到我们诊所。我想您今天是来做皮肤检查的。

segs.text: 您好，是的。我是两年前搬来澳大利亚的。在来这里之前，我都不知道做皮肤检查有多么重要。
segs.ref: Hello, yes. I moved to Australia two years ago. Before coming here, I did not know how important it was to have skin checks.

segs.text: Yes, the sun can damage your skin. That is why it is important to have a skin check every year, so that any problems can be identified early.
segs.ref: 是的，阳光会损伤您的皮肤。因此，每年做一次皮肤检查很重要，这样任何问题都可以及早发现。

segs.text: 这听起来很有道理。我对这里太阳的强烈程度感到非常惊讶，尤其是在夏天。我刚来这里时，还曾被严重晒伤过。
segs.ref: That sounds very reasonable. I was very surprised by how strong the sun is here, especially in summer. When I first came here, I was once badly sunburnt.

segs.text: Well, you only need some sunlight for your health, but it is important to protect your skin and avoid getting sunburnt.
segs.ref: 嗯，适当晒一些太阳对健康有益，但重要的是要保护好你的皮肤，避免晒伤。

segs.text: 我想确保自己的皮肤不受到伤害。有什么简单的方法吗？
segs.ref: I want to make sure my skin is not harmed. Are there any simple ways to do that?

segs.text: When you're out in the sun, it's a good idea to wear a long-sleeved T-shirt, a hat and sunglasses.
segs.ref: 当你在户外太阳底下时候，穿长袖T恤、戴上帽子和墨镜是一个好主意。

segs.text: 实际上我会戴宽檐帽子和墨镜，但是在太阳底下穿长袖T恤太热了。
segs.ref: I actually wear a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses, but it's too hot to wear a long-sleeved T-shirt in the sun.

segs.text: Perhaps you could wear cotton clothes. You'll feel cooler wearing this type of fabric.
segs.ref: 或许你可以穿棉质的衣服。如果你穿这类材质的衣服会感觉很凉爽。

segs.text: 好的，我会试试。至少如果我穿了长袖T恤，就不用在胳膊上涂防晒霜了。
segs.ref: Okay, I'll give that a try. At least if I wear a long-sleeved T-shirt, I won't have to put sunscreen on my arms.

segs.text: Don't forget, you can still get sun damage on a cloudy day, so you need to protect your skin.
segs.ref: 别忘了，即使在阴天，阳光也仍然会对皮肤造成伤害，所以您需要保护皮肤。

segs.text: 我之前从来没有听说过，真让人惊讶。听起来我以后得时刻小心阳光了。
segs.ref: I had never heard that before. That is really surprising. It sounds like I need to be careful about the sun all the time from now on.

segs.text: Yes, that is a good way to look at it. Be careful about the sun, and don't forget to use sunscreen.
segs.ref: 是的，这是一个很好的理解方式。要注意防晒，别忘了涂防晒霜。

segs.text: 好的，我会的。谢谢您。我真高兴今天来见了您。
segs.ref: Okay, I will. Thank you. I am really glad I came to see you today.

mwsqqu8283t9h.title: Community Food Pantry - Social
mwsqqu8283t9h.briefing: The following dialogue takes place in a community centre between a Mandarin-speaking unemployed people and an English-speaking social worker. They are discussing food pantry, which is used to provide food for the poor. The dialogue starts now.

segs.text: Hi, it's good to see you. You haven't been to the community centre for quite a long time.
segs.ref: 嗨，见到你真好。你已经很久没来社区中心了。

segs.text: 你好，是的，我知道我最近有经济危机，所以我几乎不出门。
segs.ref: Hello, yes, I know. I've been facing a financial crisis lately, so I hardly go out.

segs.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I have some time now, and we can talk about it. Maybe there's something I can do to help you.
segs.ref: 听到这个消息我很难过。我现在有时间，我们可以聊聊。也许我能帮到你点什么。

segs.text: 谢谢你。我失业了，我想知道我有没有资格加入社区菜园，这样我就可以自己种菜，不用买菜了。
segs.ref: Thank you. I've lost my job, and I was wondering if I'm eligible to join the community garden, so I can grow my own vegetables and avoid buying them.

segs.text: I'll check if there are any spaces for you. But as you know, it takes time to grow vegetables, so it may not help you right now.
segs.ref: 我会帮你查查是否有空位。不过，种菜需要时间，暂时可能帮不上忙。

segs.text: 我知道，但是我没办法了，我想我最近的情况不会很快好转。所以在接下来的几个月，任何能帮到我的事情，都会让我很开心的。
segs.ref: I know, but I don't have many options. I don't think my situation will improve soon, so anything that can help in the next few months would make me very happy.

segs.text: Okay, I'll check if you can join our garden. Meanwhile, if you don't have a job, you may be eligible for our community pantry.
segs.ref: 好的，我会看看你能否加入我们的菜园。同时，如果你没有工作，你可能有资格使用我们的社区食品室。

segs.text: 社区食品室？我不知道这个。
segs.ref: Community pantry? I'm not familiar with that.

segs.text: It's a stock of food donations for people who need them. You can take anything you need from the food pantry free of charge.
segs.ref: 这是专门为有需要的人提供的食品捐赠储备。你可以免费领取你需要的食物。

segs.text: 这太好了，人们捐赠食物来帮助其他人。这太有爱了，人们真大方。我们住在一个可爱的社区里，食品室是如何运作的呢？
segs.ref: That's wonderful! People donating food to help others is so kind. We live in such a lovely community. How does the pantry work?

segs.text: Our food pantry is a room in the community centre. It opens twice a week. You can just get in and pack your bag with the items you need.
segs.ref: 我们的食品室在社区中心，每周开放两次。你可以随时来，拿上你需要的食物。

segs.text: 这对我帮助非常大。如果我找到了新工作，我以后也会捐赠食物来帮助其他人。我希望是如此。
segs.ref: This would help me a lot. If I find a new job, I will also donate food to help others in the future. I hope that happens.

mwsqr3e87ps4x.title: Making an Appointment with a Social Worker - Social Welfare
mwsqr3e87ps4x.briefing: This dialogue is a phone conversation between an English-speaking staff member at the Social Services Department and a client. The client is calling to make an appointment with a social worker to get help with caring for an elderly grandmother. The dialogue begins now.

segs.text: Hello, this is the Social Services Department. How can I help you today?
segs.ref: 你好，这里是社会服务部门。请问今天有什么可以帮您？

segs.text: 你好，我想要预约和一位社工会面。
segs.ref: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with a social worker.

segs.text: Please tell me why you'd like to speak to a social worker. I need to make sure they're the right person for your needs.
segs.ref: 请告诉我您为什么想和社工谈谈。我需要确认社工是否适合您的需求。

segs.text: 我马上就要全职照顾我年迈的祖母了，我想了解一下我能得到什么帮助。
segs.ref: I'm about to start caring for my elderly grandmother full-time, and I'd like to find out what help I can get.

segs.text: We have a Carer Support unit. I can arrange an appointment for you with a team member to discuss eligibility requirements.
segs.ref: 我们有一个照顾者支援部门。我可以安排您和一位团队成员会面，讨论资格要求。

segs.text: 不用了，谢谢。这不是我今天想咨询的事情。我想和一位社工聊聊我的整体情况。
segs.ref: No, thank you. That's not what I'd like to discuss today. I'd like to speak to a social worker about my overall situation.

segs.text: I see. I can arrange an appointment with a social worker. Have you registered with the Social Services Department for any kind of support?
segs.ref: 我明白了。我可以安排您和社工会面。您之前是否在社会服务部登记申请过任何援助？

segs.text: 有的，我登记过。我目前正在接受学生援助金。
segs.ref: Yes, I have registered. I'm currently receiving student financial assistance.

segs.text: Okay, I can make an appointment for you with a social worker. At the moment, there is an appointment available in three weeks' time, on Tuesday.
segs.ref: 好的，我可以帮您预约和社工会面。目前有一个可预约的时间，是三周后的星期二。

segs.text: 那要等很久。虽然这件事不是很紧急，但如果可以的话，我希望能在几天之内见到社工。
segs.ref: That's a long wait. Although it's not very urgent, I'd like to see a social worker within the next few days if possible.

segs.text: If you're available tomorrow afternoon, there's an appointment at 3 pm that has just come up on the system.
segs.ref: 如果您明天下午有空，系统里刚刚出现了一个明天下午三点的可预约时段。

segs.text: 谢谢，这个时间对我来说更合适。请帮我预约这个时间。不过，我不知道该去哪里，因为我以前从没见过社工。
segs.ref: Thank you. That time suits me better. Please book that appointment for me. However, I don't know where to go because I've never seen a social worker before.

segs.text: Okay, you'll receive an email with the appointment time, the social worker's name, and directions to the office. It's not hard to find.
segs.ref: 好的，您会收到一封电子邮件，里面会注明预约时间、社工的姓名，以及前往办公室的路线。那里不难找。

segs.text: 好的，谢谢。感谢你的帮助。祝你下午愉快。
segs.ref: Okay, thank you. I appreciate your help. Have a lovely afternoon.

mwsqrbodvbybv.title: Community Fun Run for Local Schools - Social
mwsqrbodvbybv.briefing: This conversation is between John, a local resident, and a newcomer who has recently moved to the area. They meet in the morning and talk about a community fun run that raises money for local schools. The dialogue begins now.

segs.text: Good Morning. What a beautiful day! You look like you’ve just been exercising.
segs.ref: 早上好，今天天气真好！你看起来像是刚锻炼完。

segs.text: 你好，John。我刚刚和朋友去散步了。我通常在公园里跑步，或者绕着湖跑。
segs.ref: Hello, John. I’ve just been for a walk with a friend. I usually run in the park or around the lake.

segs.text: If you like running, you can join the community fun run next month in the park. I participate with my family every year.
segs.ref: 如果你喜欢跑步，可以参加下个月在公园举办的社区募捐跑活动。我每年都会和家人一起参加。

segs.text: 听起来很有趣，但我从来没听说过募捐跑活动。在做决定之前，我想要了解更多信息。
segs.ref: It sounds interesting, but I’ve never heard of a fun run before. I’d like to find out more before making a decision.

segs.text: You can read about it online. I'll send you the website address. It costs $30 to enter, and all the money goes to the local schools.
segs.ref: 你可以上网了解一下。我会把网址发给你。报名费是三十澳元，所有款项都会捐给当地的学校。

segs.text: 谢谢，我过会儿看看。它适合初学者吗？我开始跑步时间不长，而且很容易累。
segs.ref: Thank you. I’ll have a look later. Is it suitable for beginners? I haven’t been running for very long, and I get tired easily.

segs.text: There are different races. You can choose a shorter or longer one. If you don't want to run, that's fine, you can walk instead.
segs.ref: 活动有不同的赛程。你可以选择距离较短或较长的。如果你不想跑也没关系，可以改为步行。

segs.text: 哦，听起来不错。我会问问我朋友愿不愿意和我一起参加，或许我们可以一起跑。
segs.ref: Oh, that sounds good. I’ll ask my friend if they’d like to take part with me. Perhaps we can run together.

segs.text: That's a great idea! It's very fun, and afterwards there's a market with food and coffee.
segs.ref: 好主意！这个活动很有趣，而且结束后还有一个市集，提供食物和咖啡。

segs.text: 好的，我希望可以认识住在这里的其他人。我刚搬来不久，还没有很多朋友。
segs.ref: Great. I hope I can get to know other people who live here. I only moved here recently, and I don’t have many friends yet.

segs.text: You will meet a lot of people. Everyone is very friendly. It's also a good way to support the local school.
segs.ref: 你会见到很多人。大家都很友好。这也是支持当地学校的一个好方法。

segs.text: 你说服我了！我明天就开始训练，确保自己能跑完全程。
segs.ref: You’ve convinced me! I’ll start training tomorrow to make sure I can run the whole distance.

segs.text: That's great! Good luck with your training. See you there!
segs.ref: 太好了！祝你训练顺利。到时候见！

segs.text: 谢谢，祝你有愉快的一天！
segs.ref: Thank you. Have a lovely day!
